items.root_cause: TWO mechanisms, and only the second is a code defect. (1) A reviewed -Accept writes a TRACKED artifact and nothing in the accept said so, so the review lived only in a working tree that another step reverted. The estate already has the rule for this shape ('write the pointed-to object before the object that points to it'; 'commit the source WITH the artifact') and had no place that said it at the moment the mistake is made. (2) ONE EXIT CODE, FOUR VERDICTS, third arm of the class round 1 fixed twice today: publish-deals-page exits 2 from four different gates, the chain read only the number, and its log line, its ship summary and its alert all named the FIRST gate. The cost is the whole diagnosis, not a cosmetic wording: the alert names a subsystem that is healthy ('Check the store pulls') and never names the one that is not, so the item opens on the wrong evidence.

root_fix.what: the chain reads the gate's own HELD line instead of assuming which gate it was, in a marked region a test executes against frozen values; the accept says at the point of the mistake that its output is tracked and must be committed; the four possible subjects are registered
root_fix.exact_change: check-ad-cycles.ps1: a pure function Get-PublishHeldGate([string[]]$VerdictLines) inside '# <<PUBLISH-HELD-GATE-BEGIN>>' / '# <<PUBLISH-HELD-GATE-END>>' (the SHIP-SUMMARY and WATCHERS-DECISION convention), taking the $pubVerdict lines the chain already captures, returning gate/why/held by matching the four HELD texts publish-deals-page prints, and returning gate 'unnamed' with a why that says so for anything else; the rc-2 branch logs, summarises and mails that gate and quotes the gate's own line. The function is defined ABOVE the if/elseif chain, because a statement between a closing brace and an elseif is a parse error. audit-match-soundness.ps1: one Write-Output after the ACCEPT summary naming the baseline path, that it is TRACKED, and that an uncommitted accept is undone by the next checkout. alert-registry.json: one new PREFIX entry page-held-gate (key 'grocery page held', class page, condition 1 board-or-feed-wrong-or-held) so the three new subjects resolve; the exact entry page-held-coverage is untouched and still wins for the coverage case, because exact beats prefix.
